name: Tandoori Chicken Burger with Cucumber Raita & Spinach-Apple Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ limes
3 Granny Smith apples
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a large bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the ginger and garlic.
Add chicken, bread crumbs, and spices to the bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the chicken mixture into 6 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg ground chicken
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-7 minutes, until cooked through. Once done, transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, trim and coarsely grate cucumbers. Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber.
Place cucumber in a medium bowl, then add yogurt and salt. Whisk to combine the raita and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into in a clean large bowl. Add oil, honey, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
To assemble the burgers, spread the bottom half of each bun with half of the raita. Layer with burger patties and remaining raita, then close with the top half of the buns.
Divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
